report_list: Default Ins Plan Coverage Category List
observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 20 original screenshots, all 20 pre-rendered criteria zooms, the list zooms of 1.PNG and 2.PNG and about 40 extra crops at 3x-6x (prefix c_ in the zoom folder) were read; the left list of the other files was verified by pixel comparison (2-8 identical to 1.PNG, 9-19 identical to 20.PNG, and 1 versus 20 differ only in text anti-aliasing) plus 4x crops of 20.PNG. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (20 reports, 67 controls); they differed only in the ordering of report_list and in descriptive wording. Everything was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: the selected-radio glyph located in each file, blue-mark detection for every ticked checkbox / chosen radio, fill and border colours of every input box and button, a pixel comparison of the left list across all 20 files, and an exact-colour sweep of each criteria panel that found nothing beyond the controls listed here (no 'Page Break', no right-edge or second-column extras, no greyed control other than the two date boxes noted below, no instruction or legend text, no scrollbar, no footer text). COVERAGE: 20 screenshots = 20 different reports, each selected exactly once, in the app's row-major order: 1 Employer List, 2 Insurance Plan List, 3 Carrier List, 4 Inactive Plans List, 5 Drug List, 6 Procedure Codes List, 7 Explosion Codes List, 8 Procedure Codes by Fee Schedule, 9 Credit Codes Report, 10 Fee Schedule List, 11 Capitation Fee Schedule, 12 Office List, 13 Office Holidays, 14 Operatory List, 15 ADA Categories List, 16 Default Ins Plan Coverage Category List, 17 Document Types List, 18 Notes Macro Category List, 19 Notes Macros List, 20 Patient Types List. All are the normal two-panel screen in its default state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen - so the dialogs behind the SELECT buttons (employer, carrier, user, office / office group) and the option lists of every dropdown (STATE, CATEGORY, PRODUCTION TYPE, FEE SCHEDULE, EFFECTIVE DATE, TYPE, CLASS, CAPITATION FEE SCHEDULE, MACRO CATEGORY) are NOT documented by this category. TITLE BAR (identical in all 20): 'Setup List Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL - DIFFERENT FROM THE USUAL LAYOUT: there is NO 'SELECT REPORT' header bar. Directly under the title bar the report radios are organised under six blue group-header bars, each followed by a two-column grid of radio cells: INSURANCE = row 1 Employer List | Insurance Plan List, row 2 Carrier List | Inactive Plans List; PRESCRIPTION = Drug List (single cell, no right-hand cell); PROCEDURE = row 1 Procedure Codes List | Explosion Codes List, row 2 Procedure Codes by Fee Schedule | Credit Codes Report; FEE SCHEDULE = Fee Schedule List | Capitation Fee Schedule; OFFICE = row 1 Office List | Office Holidays, row 2 Operatory List | (empty cell); MISC = row 1 ADA Categories List | Default Ins Plan Coverage Category List, row 2 Document Types List | Notes Macro Category List, row 3 Notes Macros List | Patient Types List. report_list is given group by group from top to bottom and, inside each group, left column top-to-bottom then right column (4 INSURANCE, 1 PRESCRIPTION, 4 PROCEDURE, 2 FEE SCHEDULE, 3 OFFICE, 6 MISC), so the groups stay contiguous; the app's own item order is evidently row-major (the screenshots follow it and MISC is alphabetical that way). The new system must keep these six group headings. Each of the first five groups is closed by a thin rule carrying a small blue tab with three dots (a collapse / resize handle); a dark vertical tab with three dots on the border between the two panels is the splitter / collapse handle. The group-header bars carry nothing but their title. LIST CLIPPED AT THE BOTTOM: in all 20 screenshots the bottom edge of the window cuts the left panel inside the third MISC row (Notes Macros List | Patient Types List), about 7 px below its radios - the bottom border of that row and the rule-with-handle that closes every other group are not visible, and no scrollbar is drawn. All 20 visible reports are transcribed, but further MISC reports below the visible area cannot be ruled out. RIGHT PANEL: blue bar 'REPORT CRITERIA' with the CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end - drawn slate-grey in every screenshot while all other buttons are blue; a bordered criteria box built from grey section-header bars; footer bar with blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) at the bottom right. The same three actions appear on every report. No criteria panel is truncated: each shows the bottom border of its box with blank space under the last section. PATTERNS: every report starts with PRINT FORMAT = PDF (default) / Excel; five reports have nothing else (ADA Categories List, Default Ins Plan Coverage Category List, Document Types List, Notes Macro Category List, Patient Types List). Section headers act as the labels - pickers, dropdowns and the GROUP # text box have no label of their own, so their label is recorded as empty. Pickers are a read-only grey box (fill RGB 220,223,226) plus a blue SELECT button whose icon varies: single person for EMPLOYER and CARRIER, person-with-plus for USER, building for the office picker; every SELECT button in this category is blue (enabled). Office pickers show 108 (= the OID in the title bar), all other pickers show ALL. All dropdowns are collapsed, so only the selected value is known: ALL everywhere except Procedure Codes by Fee Schedule (FEE SCHEDULE = CIGNA PPO HAMILTON, EFFECTIVE DATE = 01/01/2020, both tenant data). Date boxes show 11/21/2026 for both start and end (apparently the capture date) with a blue calendar icon. ONLY GREYED CONTROLS: the Start Date / End Date boxes of Insurance Plan List (2.PNG) have the grey read-only/disabled fill (220,223,226) whereas those of Office Holidays (13.PNG) have the light editable fill (241,241,241). Section headers seen in this category: PRINT FORMAT, SORT BY, DATE RANGE, EMPLOYER, USER, CARRIER, GROUP #, STATE, CATEGORY, PRODUCTION TYPE, STATUS, OTHER OPTIONS, SUMMARY/DETAIL, PROCEDURE CODE TYPE, FEE SCHEDULE, EFFECTIVE DATE, TYPE, CLASS, CAPITATION FEE SCHEDULE, OFFICE/GROUP, MACRO CATEGORY. There is no REPORT FORMAT, PROVIDER, PATIENT TYPE or GROUP BY section anywhere in this category. FONT NOTE: the capital G of the UI font renders almost like a C at screenshot resolution (GROUP #, OFFICE/GROUP, DATE RANGE, CATEGORY, MACRO CATEGORY and the value CIGNA look like CROUP / RANCE / CATECORY / CICNA); each was confirmed as G by comparing the lower-right spur of the glyph with real C glyphs on the pixels. Screenshot sizes vary slightly (1364-1366 x 582-597 px; 10.PNG is cropped 2 px further left, 9.PNG and 14.PNG are 1365 px wide); the selected-radio glyph is 1 px taller in the FEE SCHEDULE row (10.PNG, 11.PNG) - a rendering detail, not a different state.

supplement_unresolved.question: STATE dropdown: the value list is not documented (only the default ALL is known) and which state of the employer record it reads is not stated. The same holds for STATE on Carrier List, where one carrier can have several claim submission addresses.

Not vendor-documented: what enables the greyed Start Date / End Date boxes of DATE RANGE (ticking Created On / Modified On?), whether both ticks can be combined, and whether unticking Include User in Filters disables the USER picker (the document says the USER selection is applied only while the box is ticked, on the strength of our capture alone). The meanings of SORT BY, DATE RANGE and USER are inferred.
What is the USER relation on Drug List - drugs created by the chosen users, or user-specific drugs? Not documented.
CATEGORY and PRODUCTION TYPE: the value lists are not given (one entry per ADA category and per scheduler production type is implied). The same dropdowns sit on Procedure Codes by Fee Schedule.

FEE SCHEDULE and EFFECTIVE DATE: the list contents are tenant data. Which effective date is preselected for a schedule, and whether the EFFECTIVE DATE list reloads when another schedule is chosen, is implied but not shown.

TYPE and CLASS dropdowns: the opened lists were never seen. The vendor defines the underlying fields (Type = Payment / Adjustment; Class = None, Insurance Payment, Capitation Payment ... for payments and None, Write-Off, Finance Charge ... for adjustments); they are recorded as likely dropdown lists but not added as options. Do the dropdowns list exactly these values, and does CLASS depend on TYPE?
Fee Schedule List: what the report prints is not documented (a catalogue of schedules, or the fees of every selected schedule), so the effect of choosing one schedule instead of ALL is unknown.
Office Holidays: what the DATE RANGE matches (holidays intersecting the range is only inferred) and whether enterprise, account-wide holidays are included is unknown.
MACRO CATEGORY: the entries other than ALL are the notes-macro categories of the account; the exact entries of the standard list are not quoted.

Older build: the old Prescription/Drug List screen offered Prescription Detail besides Drug List; only Drug List moved to the Setup List screen (the old screen was still served under Reports (Old) in a 2024 capture). Prescription Detail is not added here - confirm whether it is in scope and where it lives now.
